s1_intro: {name} listens only after you say "Hey {name}" or tap the mic.
s1_bullet1_body: your voice, for a few seconds at a time, to understand a command. The sound is processed on this phone and is **not saved or sent anywhere**.
s1_bullet2_body: your language, your name if you tell {name}, people you call often, and (only if you turn it on) your recent commands. It's locked with a key kept in your phone's secure chip.
s1_bullet3_body: only when {name} can't handle a request on the phone, the words of that request are sent to Pranix's servers to answer it. We tell you each time.
s1_bullet4_body: when you turn this on, {name} downloads the voice files it needs on Wi-Fi. After that it updates them at night, on Wi-Fi and while charging. It doesn't use your mobile data.
s1_choices: **Your choices, anytime, in Settings → {name}:** turn {name} off, see everything {name} has stored, or delete it all with one tap.
s1_contact: Questions or complaints: support@pranixailabs.com. You may also approach the Data Protection Board of India.
s1_mic_needed: Allow the microphone so {name} can listen.
s2_keep: Also keep the words I said
s2_downloads: Download voice files only on Wi-Fi while charging
s2_voice_desc: Change name and voice in QuietKeep settings
s3_body: This removes your {name} memory, saved replies and the lock key from this phone. It can't be undone. {name} will start fresh.
s3_done: Done. {name}'s data on this phone is deleted.
s4_notification: {name} is listening for "Hey {name}". Nothing is recorded. Tap to turn off.
s4_paused_resume: It will start again by itself.
s5_intro: Say "Hey {name}" three times. This helps the phone catch it when you say it. The sound is not saved.
s5_done: Done. Your "Hey {name}" will be caught better now.
s5_nothing_new: Nothing new to learn this time. "Hey {name}" keeps working as before.
s5_short_name: Short names are missed more often. A longer name works better.
s5_mic_busy: The microphone is in use. Close the other app and try again.
